text: CLI written in Python, single file password_checker.py
Policy rule: minimum length is enforced
Policy rule: uppercase requirement is enforced
Policy rule: lowercase requirement is enforced
Policy rule: digit requirement is enforced
Policy rule: symbol requirement is enforced
Policy rule: forbidden common passwords are rejected
Policy is configurable (rules can be turned on/off / values changed)
check reports every failed rule, not just the first
Compute and report Shannon entropy in bits
generate subcommand produces random passwords that satisfy the policy
Generated passwords use a cryptographically secure RNG
Policy can be loaded from policy.json
validate-policy subcommand validates a policy file and reports errors
Exit status distinguishes pass/fail (implied CLI convention)
Invalid/missing policy file handled gracefully without traceback
